#### Gas Analysis Tab

The Gas Analysis tab shows accumulated analysis results.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 660;height: 268;" />

The following items are available on this tab:

- **Effective Date** - The date for which the data is applicable.  This is dependent on contract day, contract hour and Resolution.  For Hourly Resolution, the effective date will be the day and hour the data is effective for.  For <span class="Term">Daily Resolution</span>, the effective date will be at the contract hour for the given day.  For <span class="Term">Monthly Resolution</span>, the effective date will be at the contract day and hour for the given month.
- **Activity Codes** - This column will display whether or not any of the activity codes enabled under the [System Rollup Options](../../Settings%20Manager/System/Rollup%20Configuration.md) are present for the device for a given period. The column will be highlighted an amber color if it is populated by anything and the code associated with the activity record(s) will appear. Right-clicking on a row will display the code and the associated trigger at the bottom of the context menu.
- **Relative Density**
- **Heating Value**
